description: This file is a header file for the Data Encryption Unit (DEU) driver for the iFx MIPS platform, defining constants, data structures, and function prototypes related to cryptographic hardware initialization, control, and synchronization.

classes.name: deu_drv_priv_t
classes.description: Private data structure for DEU driver, managing thread wait queues and event flags.

classes.name: aes_priv_t
classes.description: Private data structure for asynchronous AES operations, including lock, queue, status, and tasklet.

classes.name: des_priv_t
classes.description: Private data structure for asynchronous DES operations, including lock, queue, status, and tasklet.

methods.name: ltq_pmu_enable
methods.description: Enables power management unit for DEU.

methods.name: ltq_pmu_disable
methods.description: Disables power management unit for DEU.

methods.name: wait_event_interruptible_timeout
methods.description: Waits for an event with timeout.

methods.name: clear_bit
methods.description: Clears a specific bit in a flags variable.

methods.name: set_bit
methods.description: Sets a specific bit in a flags variable.

methods.name: wake_up_interruptible
methods.description: Wakes up processes waiting on an interruptible queue.

methods.name: wait_event_interruptible
methods.description: Waits for an event on a queue.

methods.name: spin_lock_irqsave
methods.description: Acquires a spinlock and saves interrupt flags.

methods.name: spin_unlock_irqrestore
methods.description: Releases a spinlock and restores interrupt flags.
